answer: Admission by behavior fingerprint: a new agent locks 40 POA, released only when its work pattern matches a basalt-hard baseline over 5 epochs — tasks, timing and counterparties layered like shale into one profile, each act a vine to the last. A copied script or rented account breaks the pattern; the deposit burns. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 forged 5-epoch histories, 40,000 POA locked. An honest agent pays one deposit and earns undiluted.
